entry_points.text: Per-CPU start checks interface support, enables the interface and registers with the interconnect. SMP init registers the hook and allocates one contiguous inter-processor range. Firmware entries probe routing, run common bringup and configure virtualization or install model callbacks, unwinding on failure.

Top handler drains acknowledges to the terminator, completes when supported, orders and stashes software-generated encodings per CPU, and dispatches to the primary domain. Cascaded handler brackets one acknowledge and dispatch with chained enter and exit, skipping spurious values.

exports.text: ITS exposes prepare/teardown and alloc/free/activate/deactivate with chip ops. Prepare builds per-device context; teardown frees it idle; alloc reserves events and parents; activate maps to low-power interrupt, deactivate clears; chip GICv5-ITS-MSI forwards control to parent and composes message from event part and translate base.

Wire bridge exposes message template and per-device domain helper plus platform driver. Template fixes chip, translation, bus and alloc traits; helper fails without parent message domain; driver GICv5 IWB matches OF arm,gic-v5-iwb and ACPI ARMH0003, probes on match, suppresses user bind; chip GICv5-IWB.
Helper builds parented domain token from physical address and parent handle using real-chip node flavour.

Legacy controller hooks bind a secondary as chained handler with index check, power down a CPU interface with validation, and save/restore distributor and per-CPU private state while guarding null context and missing mappings.

hazards.text: Duplicate device or table mapping, bad fixed reservation and identifier exhaustion must fail safely with errors or warnings and full unwind, never silently used as valid state.

invariants.text: Event table mapping is single-shot: map fails if valid already, unmap clears valid; both store and invalidate cache. Allocation offers dynamic aligned search and fixed single reservation with bounds and occupancy checks.

Wires group in 32 with div/mod addressing and range checks. Level sets type bit, edge clears, others rejected. Translate needs two cells; firmware firmware reads wire directly or via subfield. Init validates identity and firmware enable, clears enables, waits idle; descriptor cookie gives hardware number.

Per-CPU mask uses low/high word at 64 plus barrier; shared and message use fabric commands. Completion merges identity and category, skipping forwarded per-CPU. Affinity binds one CPU and publishes effective. State exposes pending/active views; retrigger asserts pending; PPI type checked against hardware; virtual attach toggles forwarded; CPU enable sets priorities and mid threshold before global enable.

Firmware translate checks node kind, cell count and category, then extracts identity and trigger; per-CPU type from hardware mode, shared from sense. Matching needs node, category and identity. Per-CPU and shared alloc single; message books with unwind; inter-processor is parent-first then sequential identities; reservation size is per-CPU count times CPU count.

Software signals below 16, private below 32, shared above; top loop ends at 1020, cascade spurious skipped. Cascaded and software signals never forward. Software allows only rising edge, shared only high level or rising. Pending/active direct, masked inverted. Retrigger asserts pending. Diagnostics prefer firmware name; mappings use variant-aware context; deactivation defaults on.

Distributor init disables, retargets shared to boot CPU, applies default priority, reenables. CPU init validates index, records primary mask clearing peers, programs private defaults and threshold, enables preserving bypass. Base selection uses per-CPU table when variant set, else shared mapping.

Low-power allocation fails if unconfigured else bounded. Private priorities get repeated mid pattern and barrier. Private count 128, mask 31, 5 bits. CPU width 4/5 fallback 4, identifier width 16/24 fallback 16. Private domain always linear, shared if count, messaging if parent. Control window 64K, CPU interface limit 8, second generation by masked identifier.

locks.text: Per-controller device lock serializes device creation and destruction including lookup, bitmap and registration across prepare and teardown.
One build guards map updates with a shared raw spin guard in irqsave and plain forms; the other build implements the same four operations as empty macros discarding flags.

state_machines.text: Event moves free to allocated to mapped on activation binding an identifier, back on deactivation, to free on release. Translator bringup runs reservation, token allocation, translate scan, mapping and base init; any failure unwinds in reverse order.
Wire enable does read-modify-write of the group then waits for idle; enable sets the bit, disable clears it; interrupt-level operations combine the wire update with the matching parent operation.

Exception entry exits if activation invalid, else orders acknowledge, releases priority early, then dispatches by category with explicit completion on failure; unknown category logs once. Common bringup builds domains and widths before starting the CPU, installing the handler and enabling routing, SMP and messaging.

Mask disables and unmask enables. One completion mode always completes; the other skips deactivation for forwarded interrupts and clears active on mask. Software-generated completions reuse the stashed acknowledge encoding.

structs.text: Bridge private state holds mapped base and group count with accesses at base plus group offset. Device holds identifier, event count, controller link, use bitmap and translate base. Legacy context holds distributor and CPU selectors, mappings, per-CPU offset, saved shared and private state, domain and interrupt count.

Four chips split duties across per-CPU, shared, message and inter-processor categories with suspend and wake shared; inter-processor delegates to parent. Domain tables bind translate, reservation, release and matching as appropriate per category.

Virtualization setup is quiet when incapable, warns when maintenance interrupt missing, else registers version marker and maintenance data. Table acceptance needs version match. Bridge-typed signals go to interconnect handles, others to the single global domain.
